sequence.title: Boot, Sensor Sampling, Classification, and Network Publish
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant boot as boot
  participant sentinel_sensor as sentinel_sensor
  participant trig_gpio as trig_gpio
  participant echo_gpio as echo_gpio
  participant timer_node as timer_node
  participant sentinel_classifier as sentinel_classifier
  participant led_gpio as led_gpio
  participant app_task as app_task
  participant wifi as wifi
  participant mqtt as mqtt
  participant logger as logger

  boot->>logger: init logging
  boot->>app_task: create/start app_task
  boot->>sentinel_sensor: sensor_driver_start()
  sentinel_sensor->>sentinel_sensor: xQueueCreate(1, sizeof(reading))
  sentinel_sensor->>trig_gpio: gpio_config(TRIG as output), set_level(0)
  sentinel_sensor->>echo_gpio: gpio_config(ECHO as input)

  loop every APP_SAMPLE_PERIOD_MS
    sentinel_sensor->>trig_gpio: set_level(1) for 10us then 0
    sentinel_sensor->>timer_node: esp_timer_get_time() for deadlines
    sentinel_sensor->>echo_gpio: wait_level(1) then wait_level(0)
    sentinel_sensor->>sentinel_sensor: compute distance_cm + valid + timestamp
  end

  sentinel_classifier->>sentinel_sensor: sensor_driver_receive(timeout_ms)
  sentinel_classifier->>led_gpio: set LED based on classification
  app_task->>wifi: connect station(ssid/password)
  app_task->>mqtt: publish record (/api/records)
  mqtt->>logger: log publish result
